turns.content: Parse 1-(3-methylbut-3-en-1-yl)-2-vinylbenzene into its two alkene-bearing substituents and locate both carbon-carbon double bonds.
With an alkene-metathesis catalyst, identify the intramolecular alkene partners and classify their substituted and terminal carbons.
For ring-closing metathesis, determine which alkene carbons form the new double bond, which ring closes onto the benzene, and what small alkene is released.
Name every organic product formed and explain why alternative ring closures do not match the atom map.
Check the complete product set by carbon balance, including whether ethene must be counted.
Verify that the products arise from metathesis of the two alkene fragments rather than another reaction class.
Report both products and the decisive ring-closing map.
